## What and why

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue:
Closes #<issue-number>

## How it was tested

List commands or acceptance steps actually run, their results and evidence links. Identify the tested revision/environment and any checks still pending. For documentation/file moves, check paths and relative links.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Correctness and acceptance criteria checked
- [ ] Maintainability and conventions checked
- [ ] Security, access boundaries and secrets checked
- [ ] Performance and resource use checked (or not applicable with reason)
- [ ] Testing and actual evidence checked
- [ ] Documentation and AI usage records updated where applicable

Add a type label and sprint milestone. Request a teammate review before merging. See [the review guide](https://github.com/CobyBurah/GroupD-SOEN341/blob/main/docs/quality/code-review.md).
